text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To stand as equals alongside Buena 
Vista"— With that goal in mind, she had 
been training relentlessly since summer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her abilities are developing without 
issue, and she's in peak physical health.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista is closing in! Buena Vista! 
Buena Vista!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: The winner is Buena Vista...!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Victoria Mile held in early summer was 
Buena Vista's first race after returning 
from her overseas expedition to Dubai, as 
well as her first mile race in quite some 
time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, it was a fast-paced track 
where front-runners didn't lose steam— a 
race where multiple disadvantages stacked 
against Buena Vista.
choice_data_list: (Even so, she still pulled off the win...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The more you learned about her, the more 
bottomless she seemed. That Umamusume was 
none other than "Buena Vista".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I am putting in the effort. But 
realistically, standing 
shoulder-to-shoulder with Buena Vista is 
no easy feat. At this rate, I might not 
make it in time—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Comparing their records and analyzing the 
race details led to a simple conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"‘Wanting to close the experience gap’... 
I see."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, Buena-san is already in the Senior 
class and has plenty of experience. She's 
even raced overseas, giving her an 
incredible ability to adapt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nodded deeply at her words. To finish 
preparing in this limited time, what she 
needs right now is richer, deeper 
experience.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For Victoire Pisa, competing against her 
generation-mates led to tremendous growth. 
Thinking along those same lines—
choice_data_list: Shall we try a mock race?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For example— Sirius Symboli, El Condor 
Pasa.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe, Tap Dance City.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after announcing her Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe challenge in July, Nakayama Festa 
now carries immense momentum toward the 
world stage—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A mock race gathering all the Umamusume 
aiming for the highest wall in the world: 
France's GⅠ race, the "Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through racing, they will surely be able 
to impart so much to Victoire Pisa as she 
is now.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I see...! Yes, please!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: And also... may I add one more thing?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I am well aware that I am lacking as I 
currently am.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Which is why I'm asking—could we hold 
multiple mock races against those with 
overseas racing experience? Within... as 
short a timeframe as possible.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I feel that breaking through the limits of 
my mind and body right here and now will 
lead me to the next step.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just a mock race, it takes a 
massive toll on both mind and body. It's 
standard practice to leave at least two to 
three weeks or more between races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you race with a shorter turnaround, 
you'll be heading into battle carrying 
accumulated fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, this race is a serious 
contest against world-class opponents far 
above her level. It's bound to take even 
more mental and physical stamina than 
usual.
choice_data_list:
(Normally, this is an offer that should be 
refused. But...)

(Normally, this is an offer I should 
refuse. But...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having walked alongside her this far, 
there was something I had faintly begun to 
sense.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: 1000! *pant*, *pant*! One more set...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how intense the training was, 
she never collapsed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without uttering a single complaint, she 
was also very stable mentally.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa is probably... no, certainly 
a girl blessed with both an exceptionally 
sturdy body and great mental resilience.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ... Please, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"This is... surely going to be the turning 
point. Whether I can catch up to Buena-san 
or not—"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Whether I have the capacity to weave a 
circle large enough to reach even my old 
friends... who remain outside of the 
racing world."
choice_data_list:
...All right. Let's proceed with the 
utmost care.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we ended up running multiple mock 
races in a short period against those who 
had overseas racing experience!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"There was plenty to do, and gathering 
members was a particularly tough battle."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm a "challenger" taking on the outside 
world too. I don't have the luxury of 
holding your hand through everything.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, running against someone with 
overseas experience sounds fun. —Count me 
in."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To my surprise, some readily agreed, while 
others tried to strike a deal—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
One of my bunch has weak hooves, you see. 
And apparently, the better the farrier, 
the harder they are to get hold of.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Most farriers would jump at the chance to 
work with a "Tracen Academy Trainer." 
...So, how about a little give-and-take?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, in the end, everyone cooperated, 
and we managed to arrange two races within 
a short span.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"—I'm a reporter from Monthly Twinkle. I 
was hoping to ask you a few questions 
about the mock race—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While drawing unexpected attention, that 
day steadily drew nearer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Phew, haah! ...It's finally next week, 
isn't it...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
You've prepared me so thoroughly to get me 
this far. I swear... I will seize victory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And now, it has finally begun! A sudden 
dream match for the autumn season!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
A 2400m battle on clockwise turf... Which 
Umamusume will conquer it...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Taaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!! 
Yaaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!! 
Daaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now, into the final straight! Victoire 
Pisa is making their move—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa clings relentlessly to her 
superior rival! However, in the final 200 
meters, she is pulled away—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—...4th place!! That wall is high after 
all...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
No, but... I felt real progress. Next time 
for sure...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Toward her next race, she continued to 
run without stopping."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
This... this isn't enough— Not yet, not 
nearly enough!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ――Yaah!!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Phew! —Nnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I shall go for one more rep...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(The way I am now isn't enough— 
Stronger...! I have to become stronger!)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(I have to give it everything—everything I 
have!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaah--!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa is in the lead. Tap Dance 
City follows, with Sirius Symboli, 
Nakayama Festa, and Manhattan Cafe—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa is currently sitting in 
sixth from the back!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(A battle of wits spanning roughly two and 
a half minutes. The state of the race is 
constantly shifting...!)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
El steadily pulls the pack forward. Tap 
follows right behind, running with steady, 
unwavering focus.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Sirius-san takes the ideal position, 
scanning the field broadly for an opening. 
And Cafe-san, not showing the slightest 
sign of ragged breath—"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: And especially... Nakayama Festa-san...!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
300 meters left— From the outside, here 
comes Nakayama Festa on the outside!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(The back that pulled ahead is drifting 
further and further away in the blink of 
an eye, 200 left—100...!)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa surges forward too! 
Followed by Sirius Symboli, Manhattan 
Cafe, and Tap Dance City—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(I won't reach—! ...E-Even if... that's 
the case...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: (I want to break past... my limits!!)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: (And—onward!!)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant, pant*!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Haa, ngh...

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: Victoire Pisa finishes in 7th place...!!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, aah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The wall built by predecessors was thick 
and unyielding—the results did not turn 
out as ideally as hoped.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, it didn't reach.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: However— what remains here is hope...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My legs—they feel remarkably light. I have 
learned so much firsthand, and my spirits 
are soaring.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I can still... go further. Surely. Without 
fail.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa brilliantly pushed through 
those seemingly grueling days, gaining so 
much. And then—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ... This is where it begins.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Could we raise the training load up 
another notch?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I can say it with my head held 
high. I can endure it. I can become 
stronger, even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"If you've been putting on the brakes, 
please take them all off."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Please, help us create a grand circle at 
the Arima Kinen...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I couldn't offer any counterargument.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The results of the two mock races were 
defeats. Even so... as she tore across the 
turf back then, a clear, bright future was 
opening up ahead of her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If it's her"— that hope was almost 
blindingly bright.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Takes a breath.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The grueling days begin once again. We 
must face them with even greater resolve.
choice_data_list:
...All right, let's go. Even further 
beyond!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes...! Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...— It seems words of comfort were 
unnecessary after all. I underestimated 
you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
On top of that... "even further beyond," 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Hmph. I don't have time to be worrying 
about other people.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Autumn deepens. The stage of dreams was 
already steadily underway.
